AccessToken.title: Personal Access Token (PAT)
AccessToken.description: Legacy auth. PATs created after 2024-12-30 expire after 24h. Leave empty and fill the OAuth fields below to renew tokens automatically.

ClientID.title: OAuth Client ID
ClientID.description: OAuth mode. Obtained via the SmartThings CLI (smartthings apps:create).

ClientSecret.title: OAuth Client Secret
ClientSecret.description: OAuth mode. Obtained via the SmartThings CLI (smartthings apps:create).

RefreshToken.title: OAuth Refresh Token
RefreshToken.description: OAuth mode. Obtained with the one-time setup helper (bin/oauth-setup.mjs). It is rotated automatically and persisted to disk afterwards.

OptionalWindFreeSwitch.title: Expose a switch to enable/disable WindFree mode

OptionalDisplaySwitch.title: Expose a switch to turn on/off the display light

IgnoredDevices.title: Devices to hide from HomeKit
IgnoredDevices.description: SmartThings device IDs or names to skip during discovery. Matching is case-insensitive. The device ID is the most reliable, since names change; both are printed in the Homebridge log at startup.

OptionalHumiditySensor.title: Expose the indoor relative humidity reported by the unit
OptionalHumiditySensor.description: Ignored on units that do not report relativeHumidityMeasurement.

OptionalFanControl.title: Expose a fan (speed, auto/manual and swing on/off)
OptionalFanControl.description: Speed and auto/manual need airConditionerFanMode, swing needs fanOscillationMode; whatever the unit does not report is left out.

OptionalSwingDirectionSwitches.title: Expose switches to set vertical/horizontal swing direction
OptionalSwingDirectionSwitches.description: Ignored on units that do not report fanOscillationMode.

OptionalAutoCleanSwitch.title: Expose a switch to enable/disable auto-clean
OptionalAutoCleanSwitch.description: Ignored on units that do not report custom.autoCleaningMode.

OptionalDryModeSwitch.title: Expose a switch to enable/disable dry (dehumidify) mode
OptionalDryModeSwitch.description: HomeKit thermostats have no dry state, so dry mode is exposed as a switch. Turning it off returns the unit to the mode it was in before.
